name: cmv-web
description: Sitio estatico de CMV preparado para correr en el puerto 5175.

scripts.dev:fix: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$pid5175 = (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5175 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess); if ($pid5175) { Stop-Process -Id $pid5175 -Force }; npm run dev"
